objective: Discover and evaluate genuinely dual-conditioned artistic QR architectures that consume both supplied reference pixels and exact QR structure.
scope: cost, latency, provenance, repair, and deterministic fallback evidence

criteria.requirement: At least three architectures are schema-proven to consume reference pixels and a separate QR control image.
criteria.evidence: Live schema verified img2img reference plus illusion QR control, with optional canny or lineart reference control.

criteria.requirement: Phase A runs each architecture on one geometric and one complex reference with exact provenance, latency, cost, and local scan evidence.
criteria.evidence: 6/6 Phase A predictions succeeded with exact hashes, cost, latency, and Core scan evidence.

criteria.requirement: Only architectures showing at least partial reference recognizability and raw decode or at least 2/8 perturbation checks expand to all eight references.
criteria.evidence: All references were clear but all candidates scored 0/8; expansion correctly stopped. A bounded strength sweep also failed qualification.

criteria.requirement: Sponsor gate requires at least 6/8 clear reference recognition and at least one raw+6/8 candidate per target without QR-dominant overlay repair.
criteria.evidence: 0/10 provider candidates passed Core scan; sponsor-ready 0/10.

criteria.requirement: All unusable outputs remain export-denied and deterministic fallback passes exact payload validation.
criteria.evidence: 10/10 provider outputs denied; 4/4 deterministic fallbacks passed threshold with exact payload equality.

criteria.requirement: Full Core gates, evidence hashes, rights handling, clean owned-scope diff, commit, and bundle verification pass.
criteria.evidence: Core 24/24, Artistic 136/136 TypeScript plus 6/6 Python, schema parse and Q5 evidence validator passed; source-bearing artifacts excluded.

architectures.reference: img2img image plus canny reference ControlNet
img2img image plus lineart reference ControlNet

allowed: up to six Phase A paid predictions
expand only qualifying architectures to remaining references

recoveryAction: Save every completed provider output immediately; resume from the first missing architecture-target pair without repeating successful paid calls.
nextTransition: Product Architect independently verifies the negative gate. Do not integrate this model or expand to the remaining six references.
